verdict.rationale: The official README documents custom context files (GEMINI.md) to tailor behavior for your projects, and the docs list a /memory command. However, a hands-on user report says the CLI consistently ignores both global and local GEMINI.md files even while reporting that the file is in use, which directly contradicts the 'agent follows' part of the story. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on file format, scoping and precedence; independent corroboration that the conventions are reliably honored.
